topSignals.title: Third consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 47 days quiet, Topsoe 72 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks, a new Tier 2 rotation round (Ceres Power, Mitsubishi Power), the Tier 3 rotation completing cycle 7 (OxEon Energy, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Miura, Delta Electronics, Shell, Denso, Thermax), every standing sweep query, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler, regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP, and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items (candidates checked and ruled out: a Craig-Hallum/Citi FuelCell Energy analyst-rating pair and a "$225M share offering" headline both resolved to mid-2026 vintage; a Rystad Energy "$30bn fuel cell investment by 2030" projection resolved to the already-logged Oct 23 sector-overview story; New Mexico Supreme Court/El Paso Electric Project Jupiter articles resolved to August-October 2026 history, already on file). No SOFC order, PPA, pilot, regulatory action, earnings move, or benchmark datapoint was found today. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21, 2026 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 47 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27, 2026 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 72 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by PTX/ammonia/SAF/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation — new cycle, round 1 (Ceres Power, Mitsubishi Power): no new stack/cell-technology items for either; results were recycled background (Ceres's Endura platform/Doosan mass-production launch recaps, MHI's Takasago SOEC test-module milestone), all pre-dated.

Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; results repeated standing enkiai.com SOFC-market recap pieces and the recirculating "Ceres Power China data centre deal" headline (already re-verified dated Nov 5, 2025 in prior entries).

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — cycle 7, round 3, completing this cycle's full 20-company roster (OxEon Energy, Nexceris, Kawasaki Heavy Industries, Miura, Delta Electronics, Shell, Denso, Thermax): no new items for any of the eight; results repeated OxEon's Oct 5, 2026 $36M DOE hydrogen-funding award (confirmed out of the 7-day window, already a month old), Nexceris's standing $60M SOEC-scaling deal and LEVER-process background, and Delta Electronics/Ceres licensing background, none dated within the lookback window.

Tier 3 sweeps — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant" and "OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura": no new item; results repeated the standing Doosan-Reverion $78M stack order and Reverion Series B background.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway, Dec 7 air-permit hearing confirmed), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
